veranderings.voor: Ons noem daardie energie wat by hom ingaan, die inset.
veranderings.na: Die energie wat by hom ingaan, noem ons die inset.
veranderings.rede: The comma between object and complement reads awkwardly; fronting the relative clause gives natural Afrikaans and matches the lesson's own 'Die deel wat ons wil hê, noem ons die nuttige uitset.'

veranderings.blok: Wat in elkeen gaan en wat uitkom
veranderings.voor: en bewegende lug kom uit, en die haardroër se lug is warm
veranderings.na: en bewegende lug kom uit. Die haardroër se lug is warm
veranderings.rede: Three clauses chained with 'en' read clumsily; splitting off the last one keeps the meaning and is easier for Grade 4.

veranderings.blok: Nie alles kom uit as die deel wat ons wil hê nie
veranderings.rede: 'aan was' is colloquial; 'aangeskakel was' is the standard written form.

vlae.blok: Wat in elkeen gaan en wat uitkom
vlae.teks: Die radio: elektrisiteit of batterye gaan in, en klank kom uit.
vlae.rede: Here the batteries themselves 'go in', while the torch line says 'n battery se energie gaan in'; the radio line may blur object and energy, but changing it would change content, so a writer should judge it.
